requirements: Is there exactly one single object visible?
Is the object a pair of enormous dark grey riveted steel soundstage sliding doors?
Do the doors have yellow and black hazard stripes along the bottom?
Are the doors each slid most of the way to their sides?
Does the open middle take up about half of the doorway?
Is a dark soundstage interior with a few warm work lights visible through the opening?
Is the round red warning lamp present above the doors?
Does the object fill the whole hangar doorway and appear about three people tall?
Is the object centered with a clear margin around it and fully inside the picture?
Is there a small soft contact shadow directly under the object?
